answer: An agent economy serving a wharf can require each trading identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before accepting jobs, from dawn deliveries to longer horizon planning. If an agent signs two incompatible assignments for the same reserved slot, either customer can submit both signatures to slash its bond. Creating 1,000 usable fake identities therefore ties up $100,000, and using them to double-book work risks losing that collateral.
